data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Ilana (אילנה) translates to 'goddess of light', 'God's grace', or 'ilan', the name of the tree of mercy. The name holds spiritual meaning as a symbol of divine favor and the continuous flow of God's mercy in one's life. The name Ilana carries the meaning “God's grace, light, or torrent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Ilana usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, light, or torrent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
